'''Carroll:''' {{legend0|#7996e2|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Don Nickles]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Don Nickles]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsOK}} The '''1998 United States Senate election in Oklahoma''' was held November 3, 1998. Republican incumbent [[Don Nickles]] won re-election to a fourth term in office over Don Carroll in a landslide. Carroll only carried [[Haskell County, Oklahoma|Haskell County]]. == General election == === Candidates === * Don Carroll, air conditioning repairman{{Cite web|url=https://news.google.com/newspapers?id=oNwyAAAAIBAJ&sjid=QQgGAAAAIBAJ&pg=4542,3031247&dq=don+nickles&hl=en|title=The Free Lance-Star - Google News Archive Search}} (Democratic) * Mike Morris (Independent) * [[Don Nickles]], incumbent U.S. senator since 1981 (Republican) * Argus W.
